[Vi+ranja+ṇa]  CL=8 ['Virajjanaṃ vigamanaṃ virāgo'] - Dispassion means fading away and departure. (Vimati 2.91)
['Virajjanaṃ virāgo'] - Dispassion means fading away. (Visuddhimagga Tika 1.18)
['Virajjati etenāti virāgo'] - That by which one becomes dispassionate is virāga. (Sarattha 3.136)
['Rāgādayo virajjanti ettha, etenāti vā virāgo'] - That in which or by which lust and other defilements fade away is virāga. (Digha Tika 2.322-3, Anguttara Tika 2.238)
Alternative analysis: vi + rāga (Digha Tthakatha 2.301)
The meanings are:
1. The Noble Path
2. Momentary cessation (khanika nirodha) of conditioned phenomena
